dependencies.component: Canonical fair-esm local checkpoint loader auxiliary

dependencies.required_by: No active CHIMERA runtime adapter identified.

dependencies.architecture: Vanilla full-backbone ProteinMPNN; 48 neighbors; canonical upstream model implementation required

dependencies.compatibility: UNKNOWN until the pinned upstream implementation loads the checkpoint and an adapter inference smoke is run.

dependencies.architecture: RFdiffusion Base; requires the upstream inference stack and its auxiliary model/configuration dependencies
